intro: Infestation Investigation is an early task given to young adventurers stepping out into Thendal Grove on Zephras Isle. Ranger Elatrell Featherlight orders a cull of pesky cirrusflies that have begun swarming the eastern groves. Left unchecked, the fast-breeding insects threaten to destabilize the peaceful grove and endanger local settlements.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: One of our rangers recently reported an infestation of cirrusflies here in Thendal Grove.
Cirrusflies can be dangerous if the swarm is allowed to grow too large, so please head to the eastern end of the Grove and exterminate as many as you can.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Such pests cannot be allowed to find root in our peaceful grove. An infestation can quickly grow dangerous if left unchecked.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Judging by the amount of bug entrails covering you, this must be quite the infestation.
